verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX 5080 page says the card can run the latest AI models locally and names Ollama, PyTorch, Windows ML and "other inference backends". The CUDA Toolkit supplies the underlying development stack. However, the evidence never documents low-precision formats (FP8/FP4) or the specific serving stacks the story asks about; fifth-gen Tensor Cores are cited only for rendering. Missing for 10: documented FP8/FP4 support for this part, explicit TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp support, any LLM inference benchmarks or hands-on corroboration.
